title: Unified Lead Ticket
description: Canonical lead and support ticket produced after channel ingestion, intent classification, and Shopify customer resolution. Every downstream system (Google Sheets CRM log, Google Chat alert, agent desktop) consumes this shape.

source_channel.description: Originating customer channel after transport normalization. Gmail is the transport for Shopify Inbox notification mail; shopify_inbox is used when the message is taken from that notification body.

name.description: Display name captured from the source payload or parsed from a Shopify Inbox notification.

handle_or_phone.description: Best stable contact key for the channel: Instagram handle, E.164 phone, or email address.

shopify_customer_id.description: Shopify Admin GID when a phone or email match exists. Null means a net-new contact.

raw_text.description: Customer message with transport boilerplate removed.

is_actionable_query.description: True when the intent gate (OpenRouter classifier in production, regex stand-in here) decides an agent should act.

vertical.description: Routing vertical used to pick the on-call agent. Typical values: apparel, beauty, home, post_purchase, general.

logged_to_google_sheet.description: True after the CRM row append succeeds.

google_chat_alert_sent.description: True after the interactive Google Chat card is posted.

assigned_agent.description: Agent or queue the card is routed to. Null leaves the ticket in the unassigned pool.
